title: commelina lyallii
intro: Commelina lyallii, commonly known as the New Zealand fan flower, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the Commelinaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Commelina lyallii include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
